description: This is a Java class implementing the ProductImageService interface, providing methods to manage product images such as adding, retrieving, and removing images in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductImageServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class managing product images, including adding, updating, retrieving, and deleting images, with integration to content management and data access layers.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductImage by its ID.

methods.name: addProductImages
methods.description: Adds multiple product images to a product, processing input streams and storing images.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a single product image, storing image content and associating it with a product.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing ProductImage entity.

methods.name: addProductImageDescription
methods.description: Associates a description with a product image.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a product image in the specified size.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the product image content by store code, product code, filename, and size.

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images for a specified product.
